svg.aria-label: EIS before polarization: the small semicircle is the bulk resistance R_b,0, and the following large semicircle is the interfacial resistance R_0. Fit with the equivalent circuit R_s in series with R_b parallel to a CPE, then in series with R_i parallel to a CPE. Program: G Potentiostatic EIS, 1 MHz to 0.1 Hz, AC 5 to 10 mV, DC 0 V vs Eoc.
